# glinet_kmwan_member (Resource)

Manage one GL.iNet multi-WAN member. The UCI section name is the stable identity.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Logical interface tracked by this member.
- `name` (String) UCI member section name, such as `wan` or `secondwan`.

### Optional

- `addr_type` (String) Address family: `4` or `6`.
- `check` (Boolean) Track reachability.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disable this member.
- `metric` (Number) Route metric.
- `track_mode` (String) Tracking mode.
- `tracks` (Set of String) Tracking probes, such as `ping,1.1.1.1`.
- `weight` (Number) Load-balancing weight.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `owner` (String) Owner token recorded with the router section. It detects another Terraform state that manages the same section.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
